terms.meaning: a separate Python file whose functions can be imported and used by another file
a line that brings functions from another file into this one

depends_on: Python standard library: sys, json, argparse

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Brings in the Python standard tools and the search functions from the slide_search_core module, including functions for domains, layout, typography, colors and background settings.
sections.why: Keeps the command-line front end separate from the search logic, so the search can be reused elsewhere.
sections.watch_out: This file cannot run if slide_search_core is missing or renamed, because the import fails at start-up.

sections.name: format_result
sections.title: Formatting one search result
sections.what: Turns one search result into readable lines, with labels that depend on the area (strategy, layout, copy, or chart). Missing fields show as N/A.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the printed output consistent for each kind of result.
sections.watch_out: The labels are typed by hand for each area, so a new data column will not appear until someone adds a line here.

sections.name: format_context
sections.title: Formatting the contextual recommendation
sections.what: Builds the printed block for a slide recommendation: inferred goal, slide position, layout, text sizes, colors, pattern break, full-screen flag, background image, and animation. Each part is printed only when the data includes it.
sections.why: Likely reason: shows the recommendation as short, scannable sections.
sections.watch_out: The values are printed as they come from the data, without checks, so a data mistake appears on screen unchanged.

sections.name: main (part 1)
sections.title: Defining search options
sections.what: Defines the command options for the search tool: search words, area, number of results, all-areas switch, JSON output, and the contextual options for slide position, total slides, and previous emotion. In contextual mode it runs the recommendation search and prints it.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets one command cover plain searches and the richer slide recommendation.
sections.watch_out: The total slides default of 9 applies when the user gives no deck length, so recommendations assume a nine-slide deck.

sections.name: main (part 2)
sections.title: Printing search results
sections.what: Prints the rest of the output: related results in contextual mode, results grouped by area when searching all areas, or a numbered list for one area. It prints a message when nothing matches.
sections.why: Likely reason: presents the results in the form each mode needs.
sections.watch_out: The contextual mode does not check for missing data files, so a missing file produces no message in that mode.

sections.name: entry point
sections.title: Starting when run directly
sections.what: Starts the search when this file is run from the command line.
sections.why: Likely reason: a standard Python pattern that lets other code load the file without running it.
